title: session.rs: no rate limiting or brute-force protection on AUTH PLAIN attempts
description: session.rs: there is no limit on the number of AUTH PLAIN attempts per session. A client can send AUTH PLAIN with arbitrary credentials indefinitely until the command_timeout fires (default 300 seconds). Each bcrypt verification takes ~100ms at cost 10, so ~3000 attempts per 300-second window are possible per connection. Combined with max_connections=100 this gives 300,000 bcrypt attempts per minute — practical brute force. RFC 4954 §6 says the server SHOULD disconnect after a configured number of failed authentication attempts. Should add a per-session auth failure counter and disconnect after e.g. 3 failures.
